credits.title: The Year of the Ghost
credits.overview: Following his father's death, Louis Hothothot turns the camera on his mother and sister in China. With fearless affection, he explores how misogyny has affected the lives of the women in his family across generations.

credits.title: Four Journeys
credits.overview: China introduced its draconian policy in 1979. In 1986, Hothothot was born. The illegality of his existence cost his father three times his annual salary and the end of a promising political career. credits.title: Awkward Apologies
credits.overview: “Awkward Apologies” is a documentary-publication project, it is the third part of my documentary “Four Journeys”. The outcomes of “Awkward Apologies” has a publication “Awkward Apologies”, and a documentary “Four Journeys-3, Awkward Apologies”.

credits.title: Mr. Hu
credits.overview: “Mr. Hu” is a portrait-film, an homage to a man, a story about a life like many others. Due to the conflicts in the Middle East, the collapsing economies and the fluctuating oil prices, Mr. Hu immigrated from Hong Kong to The Netherlands.
